title: 關係副詞 where / when＋關係代名詞混合判斷
courseTitle: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練
source: 使用者提供的 Day 10 教材

sections.title: Day 10 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天進入 **關係副詞 `where / when` + 關係代名詞混合判斷**。Day 9 已學會不能只靠「人用 who、物用 which」，今天再進一步：**先判斷後面的子句是否完整**。

由於目前沒有收到 Day 9 的實際作答成績，今天先維持 **860～900 分難度**。今天的重點不是增加題量，而是提升「拆句速度」。

建議訓練時間：**90～110 分鐘**。

sections.title: ① 今日高頻單字 30 個
sections.markdown:

今天優先掌握：

> register **for** a seminar  
> confirm a reservation  
> check availability  
> complimentary breakfast  
> reception desk  
> seating capacity  
> admission fee  
> adjacent **to**

注意 `complimentary`。

在 TOEIC 飯店情境裡：

> complimentary breakfast

通常不是「稱讚人的早餐」，而是：

**免費早餐。**

---

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜where vs. which
sections.markdown:
看：

> This is the hotel _____ we stayed last year.

先不要想 hotel 是物，所以 which。

把子句拿出來：

> we stayed _____ last year

`stay` 在這裡需要：

> stay **at the hotel**

因此空格代表：

**at the hotel**

可以使用：

> **where**

完整句：

> This is the hotel **where** we stayed last year.

---

再看：

> This is the hotel _____ we booked last year.

子句：

> we booked _____

book 缺少：

**受詞**

所以：

> which / that

完整：

> This is the hotel **which** we booked last year.

因此真正差異不是：

> 地方 → where

而是：

> **後面的子句是否缺名詞成分。**

---

sections.title: ③ 最重要判斷法
sections.markdown:
### 情況 A

> The restaurant _____ we had dinner was excellent.

子句：

> we had dinner

其實已經完整。

S = we  
V = had  
O = dinner

沒有缺主詞或受詞。

但是需要表示：

> **在那間餐廳**

所以：

> **where**

---

### 情況 B

> The restaurant _____ serves Italian food is popular.

子句：

> _____ serves Italian food

缺：

**主詞**

所以：

> which / that

不是 where。

答案：

> The restaurant **which** serves Italian food...

---

sections.title: ④ when 的判斷
sections.markdown:
看：

> Monday is the day _____ the conference begins.

子句：

> the conference begins

已經完整。

需要：

> on that day

所以：

**when**

---

再看：

> The date _____ you selected is unavailable.

子句：

> you selected _____

缺受詞。

因此：

**which / that**

不是 when。

這就是 860+ 很常見的陷阱。

---

sections.title: ⑤ where / when 的本質
sections.markdown:
可以這樣理解：

> where ≈ at/in which

例如：

> the office **where** I work

≈

> the office **in which** I work

而：

> when ≈ on/in which

例如：

> the day **when** we met

≈

> the day **on which** we met

因此考試看到：

**where / which**

不要看前面的名詞。

先檢查：

> **後面的句子完整嗎？**

完整 → where / when 的可能性提高。

不完整 → who / which / that / whom / whose。

---

sections.title: ⑥ Listening｜Part 2 進階
sections.markdown:
今天繼續訓練「答案不直接重複問題」。

### Q1

> Where is this year's sales conference being held?

(A) The venue hasn't been announced yet.  
(B) About three hundred attendees.  
(C) For two days.

答案：

**A**

---

### Q2

> When should I register for the workshop?

(A) Registration closes on Friday.  
(B) In the main auditorium.  
(C) About forty participants.

答案：

**A**

注意它沒有直接說：

> Register on Thursday.

但「星期五截止」提供了你需要的資訊。

---

### Q3

> Haven't you reserved a hotel room?

(A) I'm waiting for the conference discount code.  
(B) Near the convention center.  
(C) For three nights.

答案：

**A**

---

### Q4

> Who's catering tomorrow's reception?

(A) I think the hotel arranged it.  
(B) Around six o'clock.  
(C) About eighty guests.

答案：

**A**

---

### Q5

> Should we use the larger conference room?

(A) How many people are attending?  
(B) It's on the fourth floor.  
(C) The meeting starts at nine.

答案：

**A**

這題很重要。

問題：

> 要不要換大會議室？

最自然的回答可能是：

> 有多少人參加？

因為需要這個資訊才能做決定。

---

### Q6

> Why was the seminar postponed?

(A) The speaker's flight was canceled.  
(B) In the main auditorium.  
(C) Until next Thursday.

答案：

**A**

---

sections.title: ⑦ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天開始增加同義改寫。

限時：

**3 分鐘。**

> **WESTFIELD BUSINESS CONFERENCE**
>
> The annual Westfield Business Conference will take place at the Grandview Convention Center on October 16 and 17.
>
> Registration begins at 8:00 A.M. each day in the lobby, where attendees will receive identification badges and conference materials.
>
> The opening presentation will begin at 9:00 A.M. in the Harrison Auditorium, which has a seating capacity of 450.
>
> Participants who registered before September 30 will receive a complimentary lunch on both days. Other attendees may purchase meal tickets at the registration desk for $18.
>
> Parking is available in the garage adjacent to the convention center. Conference participants who present their identification badges will receive a 50 percent discount on parking fees.
>
> An updated schedule of presentations and workshops is available on the conference website.

### Q1

Where will attendees receive conference materials?

(A) At the parking garage  
(B) In the lobby  
(C) In the auditorium  
(D) At the hotel

### Q2

What happens at 9:00 A.M.?

(A) Registration closes  
(B) Lunch is served  
(C) The opening presentation begins  
(D) Workshops end

### Q3

Who receives free lunch?

(A) All attendees  
(B) Speakers only  
(C) Early registrants  
(D) Hotel guests

### Q4

How much is a meal ticket?

(A) $9  
(B) $16  
(C) $18  
(D) $30

### Q5

How can participants receive cheaper parking?

(A) Register online  
(B) Show their identification badge  
(C) Arrive before 8:00  
(D) Purchase a meal ticket

### Q6

The word **“adjacent”** is closest in meaning to:

(A) expensive  
(B) underground  
(C) next to  
(D) distant

答案：

**1B / 2C / 3C / 4C / 5B / 6C**

注意 Q3。

文章：

> registered before September 30

題目：

> Early registrants

這就是 TOEIC Part 7 非常重要的：

**Paraphrasing 同義改寫。**

sections.title: ⑩ 今日解析與錯題判斷
sections.markdown:
Q1：

> we held the annual meeting

S、V、O 都有。

句子完整。

需要：

> 在那間 hotel

所以：

**where**

---

Q2：

> we booked _____

缺 booked 的受詞。

所以：

**which**

---

Q3：

> registration closes

完整句。

需要表示：

> 在那一天

所以：

**when**

---

Q4：

> you requested _____

缺受詞。

所以：

**which**

---

Q5：

> _____ seats 400 guests

缺主詞。

所以：

**which**

今天如果 Q1～Q5 錯超過兩題，標記：

**G — Relative Clause Structure**

不要繼續背：

> 地方 where  
> 時間 when

真正要重新練的是：

> **關係詞後面的句子完整嗎？**

---

sections.title: ⑪ 前幾日錯題複習
sections.markdown:
今天做五題「混合反射」。

> Management considered _____ another branch.

**opening**

consider + V-ing。

---

> We look forward to _____ from you.

**hearing**

介系詞 to + V-ing。

---

> Customers were _____ with the service.

**satisfied**

感受者 → V-ed。

---

> The results were _____.

**encouraging**

造成感受 → V-ing。

---

> The employee _____ application was approved...

**whose**

whose + noun。

現在應該能在 **3～5 秒內**完成這五題。

---

sections.title: ⑫ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天不需要大量刷題，集中建立「完整／不完整子句」判斷。

看到：

> the hotel _____ we stayed

先問：

> we stayed

完整嗎？

是。

→ **where**

看到：

> the hotel _____ we booked

> we booked _____

不完整。

→ **which**

看到：

> the day _____ the meeting occurred

> the meeting occurred

完整。

→ **when**

看到：

> the date _____ we selected

> we selected _____

不完整。

→ **which**

把這四組各朗讀 **5 次**。

接著複習今天 30 個單字，尤其：

> register for  
> confirm a reservation  
> check availability  
> complimentary breakfast  
> seating capacity  
> admission fee  
> adjacent to

最後睡前重新做今天 10 題小考，第二次限制：

**2 分 30 秒**

目標：

**10/10。**

### Day 10 達標標準

如果第一次：

**9～10 / 10 且 ≤ 3 分鐘** → 已可提高到 900 分題型。

**7～8 / 10** → 維持 860+，增加關係子句混合題。

**≤ 6 / 10** → Day 11 會保留更多關代／關副複習。

今天最重要的一句不是「地點用 where、時間用 when」，而是：

> **關係詞題先遮住空格，檢查後面的子句是否已經完整。**

**Day 11** 將進入 **連接詞 vs. 介系詞：because / because of、although / despite、during / while**。這是 Part 5 非常容易失分、也非常值得建立秒判能力的一組題型。
